text:
Alex P: ok team — CloudScale marketplace listing + joint GTM. We need a final readiness checklist and an embargoed PR schedule. who owns what? :calendar:
Maya R: I'll own the landing page copy and hero. draft ready tomorrow EOD. can someone confirm brand rules for co-logo?
Samir K: engineering will finish the listing integration tests today. staging listing URL: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/cloudscale. ping me if you need test creds.
Jordan L: assets: partner logos (svg/png) + lively screenshots. CloudScale legal asked for final logo lock by THU. i uploaded a zip: s3://redwood-assets/partners/cloudscale/logos_v3.zip
Tanya C: PR check — embargo window we proposed was Nov 7 09:00 PT. PR Liaison, can you confirm distribution list + embargo note for partners?
PR Liaison: Confirmed. embargo: 2028-11-07T09:00:00-07:00 PT. distribution: tech press list + partner channels + cloud marketplace page. sending draft release in DMs for approval.
PartnerBot: Reminder: action items due in 48h: logos, landing copy, marketplace metadata, partner approvals. See /tasks #partnerships.
Maya R: quick copy idea for hero: "Run LLM inference at production scale — now available on CloudScale Marketplace." short sub: "Unified billing, predictable throughput, turnkey deploys." thoughts?
Alex P: short and punchy — ok. add one CTA for "Try on CloudScale" and another for "Read integration guide". Maya will you add UTM tags?
Maya R: yes — will append UTM params. sample CTA link: https://redwood.ai/cloudscale?utm_source=marketplace&utm_campaign=cloudscale_launch
Samir K: FYI marketplace metadata that QA needs:
```
{
  "product_name": "Redwood Inference for CloudScale",
  "version": "v1.0",
  "regions": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"],
  "support_contact": "support@redwood.ai"
}
```
I tested deploy flow and example template. Logs show one minor warn on image size, not blocking.
Jordan L: legal note — partner requested a brief co-marketing blurb. proposed copy uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CloudScaleCoMarketing. need sign-off from CloudScale PM (Arun).
Tanya C: press plan: embargo -> send release to top tier (The Register, TechCrunch), then targeted vertical outlets (finserv, health). also coordinate partner blog + Redwood blog same morning 09:05 PT.
PR Liaison: I'll stagger outreach: exclusive to TechCrunch (10min lead), then full wire at 09:05 PT. need final quotes by Nov 3 COB. Alex can you provide CEO quote?
Alex P: yes I'll draft CEO quote by Tue morning. keep it short about partnership & performance benefits.
Maya R: design needs final hero screenshot + co-logo lock by Thu noon to finalize responsive layouts.
Samir K: two engineering blockers: (1) marketplace accepts only tar.gz vs our usual zip — will include small wrapper script, (2) dependency on model artifact hash — need partner to pin the model id. both are being handled.
Jordan L: approvals timeline: internal legal sign-off by Nov 2, partner legal sign-off by Nov 4. tagging @CloudScale PM to expedite.
Tanya C: checklist (quick): 
- [ ] logos signed
- [ ] landing copy complete
- [ ] marketplace metadata validated
- [ ] PR embargo + distribution confirmed
- [ ] partner blog draft
- [ ] tracking UTM & analytics setup
Who can own tracking?
Samir K: I can add analytics hooks to the example deploy and confirm tracking events.
Alex P: assigning owners: Maya (landing + CTAs), Jordan (assets + legal), Samir (integration + tracking), Tanya (PR schedule), Alex (quotes + exec comms).
PartnerBot: Task update: Maya R assigned landing-copy (due 1835080000), Jordan L assigned partner-assets (due 1835060000).
Maya R: small ask — can design get a 2hr sync today? need to align thumb sizes and spacing for marketplace card.
Jordan L: ok will book 2pm PT.
PR Liaison: final note — embargo requires partners to cc our PR inbox on approvals. please send approvals to pr@redwood.ai. I'll post the final press release here for one last read-through 11/6.
Alex P: awesome. let's keep updates in this thread; if anything slips tag me. thanks everyone :rocket:
